balls.text: Full toss is heaved behind square! Cummins took guard around middle and stood still, helped it over with a flick. Second-row six.
Slow ball's halfway into the pitch and over middle, Aniket tries to ramp it over third but misses

Two stolen, throw from long-off to the keeper is too wide. Another yorker attempted, was a full ball in the end, at the stumps, Aniket tried to launch it straight, got it off the outer-toe of the bat.
Yorker missed, 150 up for SRH. Low full toss with pace, picked up from just under the knee-roll. Bat goes from low to highhhh, 78 metres behind square it flies
Length is the new slot. It's wide too, Aniket goes back in the crease and slaps it over cover
Yorker at the stumps, jammed to long-on. They gamble a two and make it. Ump signals one short, Aniket reached out but didn't touch the non-striker's crease anyway

Cummins tries the double-bluff, skis left and right, was on fourth stump with all three stumps visible when the full ball was released. Wide not given. SRH review. It landed on middle and leg, went past the flick and just missed leg stump. It's too close to the stumps, says the third ump. No wide
Low fully on off, Aniket was shuffling about in the crease and hit it while being beside the line. Opens the face to drive to deep cover
Ankle-high full toss on middle, Cummins clears his front leg and flicks towards long-on
Finally, the yorker connects. At the crease and the stumps, blocked straight
Another yorker attempted, it's a very low full toss on off, steered to deep point

Batter and bowler miss, off stump's uprooted. Bumrah went for the yorker, bowled a low full toss, but Klaasen - who had made ample room - tried to carve it square but got beaten. Bumrah raises his hand with a smile.
Wide on a length, cut to deep point
MI not getting away now. Missed yorker turns into a thigh-high full toss, Klaasen helps it over fine leg with a flick. Hardik pulls out his 'what was that?' face to the bowler
Slower short ball rises around rib-height, Klaasen pulls it with power. Ball races through cow corner
That's slot. Whacked wide of long-on. The ball was angling towards leg stump, Klaasen - with a diagonal stance - could swing through the line
Scythed over cover point, Santner was the sweeper running right but that skimmed away from him. Klaasen shakes his head but that could be the release shot he needed
Wide bouncer attempted. Looked slow, spongy bounce takes it above Klaasen's cut... and his head
Semi-helicopter shot as Klaasen didn't follow through fully. On the bounce to long-on. Was a full ball just down leg, the front leg cleared, he got room but not placement
Shin-high full toss on off, worked to long-on
Helicoptered... straight to long-on. 139ks cross-seam half-volley, was a missed yorker, Reddy was deep in the crease and tried to go squarer. Got it off the bottom of the bat.
Klaasen misses out. Low full toss on off but MI are getting away with missed yorkers. Cleared the front leg and tried to clatter it with the angle over midwicket, miscued it to long-on
Bump ball? Likely, not sure they're checking. Another yorker attempted, was on off, Klaasen tried to whip it across. Got block-holed, the ball went off the ground back to Boult
Boult confidently appeals for lbw, not much support. Did it pitch outside leg or hit bat? Klaasen's front foot slid outside off, body going square-on for the lap sweep.
Yorker on leg, clipped to long-on

High-ish full toss, gets away with it. The ball was just over middle stump, higher than Klaasen would've liked while waiting with a stable base with the back slightly bent. He wanted to swing leg side, could only jam it back to the bowler

Angle on the yorker is sharp. Goes past the flick, down leg. Wide called. Klaasen and Bumrah have a chat, likely whether if it brushed the pad. MI review. All three stumps were visible, so it would be wide on line. Ball's close to the edge of the front pad... But there's no contact spotted on Ultra-Edge. Wide called
Another yorker attempted. It ends up as a shin-high full toss on off, Nitish whips it off the bottom of the bat. One bounce to long-on
Low full toss on leg, whipped to long-on. Pace on
Slower one into the pitch, pulled nicely, SKY overruns to the right from long-on, but reaches back and clings low to the ball while sliding down. Great stop.
And Reddy telegraphs the reverse ramp, can only under-edge it onto pad and it deflects behind point. Was a length ball on fourth
Klaasen looks to whip the attempted yorker through midwicket. Inside edges it onto pad, it deflects to the off side
One more yorker, Boult continues to nail them. Lands on the crease, angles to middle, Klaasen stays leg side and flicks through square leg
So many yorkers today, that's another one. On middle, jammed to long-off
Klaasen goes across to fourth, Boult smartly spears in a 135ks yorker on middle. Klaasen has to shuffle back to jam it to long-on
Full ball down leg, goes past the flick
Edged, beats short third. SRH's 100 is up. Bumrah the fielder, the ball went to his left and bounced big too. Was a slower length ball outside off that Klaasen wanted to slap square. Got an edge
Full on off, driven to long-off
Low full toss on middle at 133ks, Reddy whips it to long-on
Good yorker. Landed around the crease and was heading towards leg stump, Reddy cleared his feet and jammed it back to the bowler with a straight bat
Reddy takes a step across, Pandya sees him and goes wider with the fullish slow ball. Reddy looks to slash it square, toes it to short third
Nearly a chop-on, ball angles away over middle stump after bouncing. Was an offcutter on a length at sixth stump that Klaasen tried cutting
Pace-on bumper. Very short, fifth-stump line. Rises around neck-height, Reddy pulls it into the ground. Single to micwicket
Slow on a length at fifth, Klaasen looks to punch it through cover with a semi-horizontal bat, gets it to long-off from the bottom-half
More slingy from Santner there, more of a 10 o' clock release. Length on off, punched to long-off
Length on middle, punched to cover off the back foot
Length on leg, 95ks, no spin, worked through midwicket
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket
Quick single to midwicket. Fullish ball was flicked.

Reverse swept over short third! Likely pre-meditated but the stance-change was late, the front foot was in front of middle and the down-to-up bat swing took the full loopy ball on fourth with the spin
Length on fifth, cut back to the bowler.
Makes room and cuts the length ball, at the stumps, to point
Uppish but goes low to the bowler and on the bounce. Length ball at the stumps, Klaasen was beside the ball and punched it with a straight bat
Length down leg, past the flick to the keeper
Flatter length ball around off, jammed to midwicket with a straight bat
Length on off, clipped off the back foot with the turn to midwicket

Head's stuttering innings ends. He holes out to long-off and Jacks is delighted. Was a 93ks length ball around sixth stump, looked slower, Head made room and tried to carve it but the toed the ball. Bottom hand came off and Santner took an easy catch
Wide on a shortish length, sits up and spins away. Let go
Head makes room again and gets another full ball at the stumps, slaps it hard straight to long-off. 20 balls since the last boundary
Reddy tries to bash the slower ball across the line, bottom hand comes off upon impact. The fullish ball, angling towards the off-side tramline, goes through midwicket
Boult keeps it full. Goes for the pace-on yorker, gets it a touch fuller than the crease. Head has room to slap it to long-of
Low full toss on the boot, Reddy reaches low and to the left to work it to long-on
Head shows all three stumps and thrashes the middle-stump full ball to long-on
Slower one, chipped over the bowler. Full ball on fourth, punched with a straight bat
Short ball, pulled out to deep midwicket
Slower bouncer outside off, Reddy doesn't offer a shot. Maybe he thought it would be a wide, but the umpire doesn't signal anything

Short and angled across, Head is on his toes as he slaps it down the ground. A lot of height, not enough distance and it's caught at long-on. Doesn't matter of course, and the free hit goes for just one run

Hardik has now removed Travishek! But wait, the siren goes up! This is full on the pads, Head looks to swing it away and picks out deep midwicket. Hardik has overstepped! Head gets lucky, like Abhishek did against PBKS!
Sways back to ramp it, and it goes to Bumrah at deep third on the bounce. Offcutter bouncer outside off, NKR didn't have any pace to work with there
Slower bouncer outside off, Reddy contemplates the ramp but keeps away in the end
In the blockhole and Head backs away to work it down to long-on's left
On a length outside off, spinning away, Head manages to squeeze it past extra cover
Length ball outside off spins in, Reddy ticks it to midwicket's right for a single

Jacks does the job! Kishan's struggles continue! Floated on a length outside off and it spins away past Kishan's bat as he comes down the track to hit it inside out. Rickelton does the rest and Jacks is pumped, Hardik is delighted!
Full around leg, Head drives it out to long-on
On a length outside off, Kishan tucks it towards long-on. That spun away quite sharply!
Tossed up otuside off, Head reaches for it and gets an inside edge past the leg stump!
Full toss outside off, driven out to the off side sweeper

Almost a second wicket for Pandya! Another short ball angled across the left-hander, Head slaps it to Trent Boult's right at backward point. Boult takes a few steps and dives for it, but it goes wide of the fielder. Pandya frustrated at that
Hardik goes short and across, Kishan pulls it in front on the leg side for a single

And Hardik gets a wicket! This is dug into the pitch around middle and leg and it seams away. Abhishek goes deep in his crease and looks to cut it away. Raj Bawa at the boundary misjudges it initially and but does well to reach forward and grab it! A smile of relief from the fielder, a pumping of fists from Hardik!

Slashed fine of backward point! Full toss outside off and Abhishek slices it fine on the off side! Picks the gap nicely, as that was at catching height. In more bad news for Mumbai Indians, Hardik Pandya is limping Could be a problem with his ankle, seemingly.
Short ball on middle and angled across him, Head stands tall and pulls it along the ground to deep backward square
Starts off trying the wide yorker, but overdoes the line! Called wide immediately
On a length outside off, Abhishek slashes at it and gets an inside edge onto the ground
Head skips down the track again and lofts it over cover, but can't beat the fielder in the deep
Jacks throws this one up wide and Head misses out as he reaches for it
No luck involved there! Tossed up on middle and Head gives charge and hits it over the bowler's head!
Gets an edge that goes fine of short third! On a length outside off and he had a go and gets lucky again
Slaps this length ball out to sweeper cover's left for a single
On a length around middle, Head is able to drive it past a diving cover fielder and ends the over with a single. Just three off the last over of the powerplay. Excellent stuff from Bumrah
Full toss on the stumps, Head backs away and drives it to extra cover
Bumrah with a yorker on the stumps and Head looks to swing it away, only to get an inside edge onto his pads!
Yorker around off, pushed towards cover and Abhishek takes off for a quick single
Another slower ball, around off this time. Head wants to play it on the off side and gets an inside edge fine on the leg side
Offcutter on a length on off again and the lack of pace deceives Head, who loses his shape as he looks to swat it away
Length ball angled across and the change in angle nearly works immediately! Abhishek slaps it on the off side and it goes just to the cover fielder's left. He chases it down to keep it to two
Slapped over cover again! Length ball angling into Abhishek and he makes room leg side again and flays this on the off side!
Imperious! Skips out of his crease to this slot ball while moving leg side and goes inside out over cover!
Finds the gap on the off side. Yorker outside off and Abhishek drives it through point with an open face. He's been the one giving SRH the momentum early on
Now Chahar goes short and Abhishek sways back to have a ramp, but misses
Very full outside off, pace off, and Abhishek is early into his big swing. The ball sneaks past
Fuller on the pads now, 139kph, and Abhishek is able to whip it away to deep backward square. Seven runs off Bumrah's first over
Slower ball around off, off cutter, and Abhishek fends it back towards the bowler
Edge flies over the keeper! Bymrah goes short outside off and Abhishek has a swipe across the line. Gets a thick edge that flies high over the keeper and races away
On a length around off, Head pushes it behind point and gets an easy run
Goes for the yorker around off, Abhishek digs it out towards mid-off for a quick single
Gets some movement away from the left-hander straight away. On a length outside off, it's an off cutter and it seams away to beat the outside edge as Abhishek looks to go inside out
Low tull toss outside off, Abhishek swats it towards long-on for a single to close the over
Short and wide, angled across. Abhishek again backs away while giving charge to cut, but misses. This time the umpire reckons it's too high

Another chance for Karn Sharma! Abhishek gives charge and has a swipe at this length ball. Just short of Karn Sharma, and it seems to have hurt him. Karn Sharma is going off the pitch immediately to get treatment! This could spell trouble for MI, as he is one of their frontline bowlers today
Lovely shot! Right in the slot, Abhishek clears his front leg and does well to keep his balance as he lofts it down the ground. One bounce and four

Chahar continues to go short. Abhishek backs away leg side while charging down and looks to slash it away on the off side but misses again. Chahar enquires if there was an edge, but no one is interested
Another short ball angled across Abhishek, who picks out the midwicket fielder with the pull
Back of a length angled across him, Abhishek looks to pull but can't connect
Wayward from Deepak Chahar there. Full down leg
Good connection on that one! Dispatched through mid-off! In the slot around off and Head backs away and pumps it straight of the mid-off fielder
Head gives charge now to this length ball and slaps it out  on the bounce to extra cover. His bottom hand came off, and he is lucky that didn't carry to the fielder
Swing and a miss! Boult pulls his length back and Head swipes across the line to only find thin air. That just carries over the stumps!
Now Boult slides one down leg as Head looks to flick and misses
Full around middle and leg, Abhishek flicks it away aerially towards backward square leg. Didn't quite get a hold of that
Beats mid-on! And we have our first boundary. Full and straight on leg, Abhishek gives charge and just punches it past the non-striker. Mid-on scrambles to his right but it's too straight of him
ON a length around middle, swinging away, and Abhishek punches it back to him
Very full outside off, Abhishek drives it out to deep point with an open face
Now Head slaps this to point where Dhir grabs it and throws it very high, that goes over Rickelton and Jacks both, allowing the single!

Another chance, or just short? It's all happening at the Wankhede! Outswinger around middle as well, Head looks to whip it leg side and it goes to Karn Sharma at midwicket.And it's just dropped short!
On a length around middle, swing away from Head, who parries it back
Full around middle and leg, Abhishek backs away leg side and drives through cover. Good job  by the infielder to chase that down
Chance first up! Abhishek gives charge to this length ball and looks to go inside out. Gets a thick edge that goes above Will Jacks at first slip. It bursts through his hand! What a start
reverse swept between short third and point. It was in the air for a while, but he managed to find the gap.  MI have won, finally!
hard length outside off, pushed to point. Looks for a single but is sent back

hits him flush on the toe, Naman Dhir is gone! But he reviews and you'd think he's a goner. It's the dipping yorker on middle, Dhir looks to scoop it fine but misses. Replays confirm there's no bat. That's headed just one way - middle of middle. Dhir started to walk off even before a decision was flashed on the big screen.
yorker-length, hint of late tail, pushed to midwicket
full toss, hits it straight to midwicket.

shovelled straight down deep midwicket's throat! Hardik brought out the helicopter but ended up hitting it straight to the fielder. Walks off looking at his bat, he's seemingly unhappy with the connection. Super little innings nonetheless. Walks off with a smile
bowls a high full toss into the body, Tilak looks to work it square and gets a leading edge that bounces to third man.
slashed to square third for a single
drilled to long-off
dribbles away to the third man boundary! Hardik wants to waste no time. This was a slower and fuller delivery again, Hardik throws the kitchen sink and gets a thick edge over short third.
clobbered! Slower, fuller and right in the slot as Hardik hammers this over long-on. Flat hit. Cummins got there, moving a few yards to his right, and got his fingers on the ball but couldn't hold on
sits up nicely as Tilak pulls the short ball to deep square
pulled away towards long leg, good work by Nitish to save two
steps out to hack this full toss into the leg side for a single
drilled over mid-off! Too full from Malinga and Tilak timed that superbly.
attempts the short-arm jab again, ends up bunting it gently to midwicket. Nitish hits the stumps direct at the striker's end but Tilak was well in
flicks this down to deep midwicket
full outside off, eased to deep point
short and he's pulled that to deep square
that's a Hardik special!  Waits on it and then plays a superb short-arm jab that speeds through midwicket
short of length, slower but too far wide outside off, Hardik lets it pass
picks the gap between point and square third. This was short and wide, Hardik flayed that away, it didn't matter that he hit it in the sir for a while. Sweet timing!
sways out of the way of this short ball outside off
slaps that straight to mid-off! Cummins digs this into the pitch on a length outside off, it seemed to have stopped on Jacks who was through with the shot and didn't get any timing on it
takes him on with the hook, but can't get enough bat on it, Harshal grabs that on the bounce at fine leg.
rises with the bounce and dabs this short of length delivery to point
steps out to force that through the line, ends up getting a thickish inside edge that rolls down to fine leg. Once again the ball didn't quite come on as Harshal bowled it into the pitch
helps this short ball all along the ground to long leg
flicks this slower and fuller delivery to deep square leg
forced through the line to extra cover
off the edge, down to third man where Malinga slides around to save three runs. Covered good ground and dived full stretch
slower ball dug into the pitch as it angles in, punched past mid-on
works it wide of midwicket for a single
superb bumper into the body from around the stumps, Tilak ducks under it as the ball whizzes past his ears
lofted through the line but SKY hit it on the top part of the bat, so didn't generate any power or timing. Ansari takes the simplest of catches at mid-off.
bails out of this short ball outside off after initially giving the impression he was taking him on
was through with the swing over deep square even before this slower ball arrived, beaten!
slower delivery, way too short and too much width and SKY slashes it over short third, deliberately done.
hammers this high full toss over midwicket and it races away. The extra ball has disappeared. The sense of despondency in the SRH camp shows.
slips this way outside off as he tries to roll his fingers over the seam
whips this full toss straight to midwicket.
flicks this slower and fuller delivery outside off to deep square
dug in short, SKY holds his shape and then with both feet in the air, uses the room to thrash it up and over backward point.
squeezes this yorker-length delivery to point
full on middle, worked to long-on
goes against the turn but SKY has picked the bones of it, clears the short leg-side boundary at wide long on quite comfortably
chops this to point, skidded through but didn't have as much room as he would've liked
reaches out to scythe this through point, Cummins half-stopped to take pace off
flatter and fuller on middle, worked to long-on. Required rate under seven an over now
hammered back, good stop by the bowler on his followthrough
tossed up on middle Jacks clears his front leg and slogs that way into the stand at long-on! Massive hit.
ON a length outside off, swatted down the ground to long-off. Mumbai Indians 91 for 2 at the halfway mark
On a length around off, Surya pushes it out through point for a single
Tossed up full outside off, driven along the carpet to sweeper cover
On a length outside off, slapped out to cover
Pulled away with disdain! Half-tracker and he rocks back to hammer it over deep midwicket
Floated full and drifting in to pitch on off, pushed to the off side
Hello, SKY! This is too full on leg and Suryakumar gets down to sweep it high over fine leg and into the stands
Suryakumar Yadav gets down to sweep and misses. This was a legbreak tossed full outside off. Surely impact was outside off and the ball would have likely missed the wickets as well
Full around middle, this one goes on with the angle. He backs away and punches it down the ground wide of long-on
Dropped a bit short outside off, slapped straight to the extra cover fielder
Inside edge goes past the stumps and races away! Legbreak on off, Jacks pushes at it and gets lucky
Tossed up on leg, SKY eases it out to long-on
On a length outside off, tucked out through midwicket and gets a single to get off the mark immediately

Skied and taken! Rickelton's second life doesn't last long, but he has added some quick runs. Harshal bowls an offcutter wide of off, Rickelton reaches out as he looks to go inside out and gets an edge that goes up. Head at backward point backtracks and settles under it
Takes on the bouncer now! Dug in short and angled across Rickelton, and he has enough room to free his arms and pull it square
Length ball on the pads and Rickelton says 'thank you very much'. Helps it along beyond square and it's in the gap for four
On a length outside off, swung away to deep midwicket
Very full outside off, driven along the carpet to long-off
Tosses it up and it's a low full toss around off, pushed to extra cover
Tossed up wide of off and Rickelton slaps it out to long-off on the bounce
Ansari looks to go wide and gets it beyond the wide line. So he'll have to bowl that again

Cummins holds on at cover! This is a rank long hop and  Rickelton backs away to slap it away. It's gone to Cummins' right and he takes a nice catch diving to his right Scratch all that! Klaasen's gloves were in front of the stumps when Rickelton hits that, so it's a no-ball! SKY was out in the middle, Rickelton was back in the hut. And now he'll be back in the middle. One South African wicketkeeper giving another a reprieve! We saw the return crease no-ball from Starc yesterday, and today this! Zeeshan Ansari lets out a frustrated smile
Now Rickelton moves leg side and looks to slog it. It's the googly from Ansari and beats the outside edge
Length ball angled across, Rickelton gets an inside edge onto the ground as the ball squeezes out towards extra cover
Rickelton misses his sweep to this full ball around off. Mild appeal for lbw, but that was likely impact outside off, and hence also missing wickets
Starts off with a legbreak on a length on leg, Jacks goes back and tucks it out through midwicket
On a length outside off, Jacks looks to drive and gets a thick edge to short third on the bounce
Full outside off and angling in, Rickelton eases it out to deep square leg
Lovely drive! Low full toss outside off and he creams it wide of the mid-off fielder
Two in a row for Ricks! This is a short ball that sits up nicely for him and he swings it away through square leg. Harshal running to his right from deep backward square can't stop that
Rickelton will feel much better now! He had been struggling so far but gets a hold of this! Slower ball, but in the slot around off, and he lofts it over mid-off
On a length outside off, tucked away to deep backward square
Head, what have you done? He's put down a sitter! Jacks slaps this length ball in front of point and it goes to Head's left at cover. Was a simple catch, but he lets the ball slip through his hands!
Jacks gets going! It's an offcutter but in the slot around off, Jacks backs away and flat-bats this straight of mid-off
On a length around off, Jacks clips it to midwicket
Swung away through square leg off the inside half as Ricke;ton continues to struggle to middle it. This was the offcutter from Shami
Rickelton looks to break the shackles, gives Shami the charge and throws his bat at this length ball and slices it over cover point
Back of length outside off and angling in, punched to cover
On a length around off, tucked to midwicket
He's hit a full toss to cover! And it's Travis Head who pouches it there! Low full toss outside off, it was a hit-me ball, but Rohit picks out Head. SRH strike their first blow!
Rohit skips across the stumps, Cummins follows him and bowls it wide and gets the ball to evade Rohit's swing across the line
Full and angled across, Rickelton looks to whip it leg side and gets it out to deep square off the inside half. He's yet to find his timing
Full outside off, Rohit skips out and drives to mid-off's left
There he goes again! This is full around off and Rohit uses those strong wrists to whip it square. Into the stands and that's his third six today

Slapped away on the bounce to deep backward point running to his right. Length ball angled across and Rohit slashed it behind point. 17 runs off that over will take off the early pressure built on Mumbai Indians in the first two overs
Into the second tier! That's vintage Rohit Sharma! Gets one on his hips and he doesn't hesitate in helping it along behind square leg
Rohit was much more in control of that as he backs away to this short of good length delivery and slaps it away in the gap at cover. Nitish Kumar Reddy again does well to chase that down and save two

Edge flies over the slip fielder! And it lands on the boundary rope! Length ball seaming away and Rohit wants to hoick it leg-side. But he didn't have much clue as it takes a thick edge and lands full on the boundary rope. His 100th IPL six at the Wankhede, according to Harsha Bhogle on TV
Lovely shape away as Shami goes full outside off. Rohit was looking for a drive down the ground but is comfortably beaten! There's that famed seam position from Shami!
Back of a length outside off, Rohit pulls it on the bounce and Aniket at midwicket does well to dive to his right to get a hand to it and slow it down. Saved two runs there

Excellent fielding! Overpitched just outside off, Rohit looks to put it away with a square drive, but Reddy at cover point is very quick to fling himself to his left to keep that down to just one run. Only seven off the first two
Full around middle and off, swung away to deep backward square. Came off the inside half of the bat
Beats the edge! 136kph full delivery goes across Rickelton as he looks to drive it on the off side
On a length outside off, pushed to the point fielder's left for a single
Short of good length outside off, Rohit tucks it to midwicket's right off the bottom half of the bat
Starts off with a length ball angling in from outside off, Rohit meets it with a firm defense
On a length outside off, Rickelton pokes at it as it straightens off the pitch and gets it out to short third. Good start for Shami
Full around off, angling in from the angle around the wicket, Rickelton clips it square and gets two as the fielder runs across from deep backward square
Full and straight, Rohit misses his flick and it goes towards square leg off his left pad
Rohit dances down first up and swishes at thin air! Back of a length outside off, and the ball straightens off the pitch as Rohit looks to slap it away! beats the outside edge
On a length outside off, punched out to deep backward square
Pitches it up full outside off, Rickelton drives it square but Reddy makes a good stop at point to his right
